origin: Hypothesis generated by the four-visitor-history exploratory mutational-access priority pilot in data/results/chapter2_island_mutational_priority_pilot_20261008.json; none of those histories reused.
mutational_masks: Identical to pilot: assurance_first first 150 only A+X mutable, investment_first only I+X mutable, both_early all mutable, both_delayed only X mutable. All I and A mutable t150 onward.
founders: Identical founder genotypes across treatments; all I and A founding alleles clamped to 0.5; matching founder variance retained.
primary_estimand: For each independent history calculate [assurance_first minus investment_first] on the far-pre minus near-pre terminal occupancy contrast, integrated equally across 4 ovule-budget stress levels and 2 post-pollination regimes, separately by setting. Primary test is prior_selfing priority interaction minus pollen_discount priority interaction, averaged across 16 independent visitor histories.
primary_gate: Mean contrast difference (prior minus pollen_discount) > 0 and lower endpoint of predeclared 95% history bootstrap > 0. Do NOT additionally require one setting's priority sign to be positive or negative; report both individually.
secondary: Independent history bootstrap intervals for each of 4 setting-specific priority interactions, plus all four access schedules and mid-genetic outcomes regardless of sign
admissibility: All 512 prehistory cases and all 4096 poststress outcomes must exist and pass source checks. Extinction at t400 before bottleneck is a failure to generate the planned counterfactual, not a trait value zero; do not silently drop
claim_boundary: This independent cohort is generated AFTER seeing the 4-history pilot: one hypothesis is frozen for 16 new histories, not a universal post hoc discovery.
Initial standing genetic variation for I and A was removed; unlike original generality work.
Mutation-access timing entails different duration of mutational supply and is not an isolated manipulation of observed phenotypic-change order.
The same synthetic stress range was informed by previous demographic pilots; never claim natural-island demographic probability.
Only 16 visitor histories with a single demographic repeat per history; account for finite stochastic uncertainty and do not count 4096 cases as independent.
If the prespecified prior-minus-pollen contrast fails its two-sided CI direction gate, report failure without retuning.
The earlier independent 64-history payoff 4-of-5 result remains an overall FAILED gate and is unrelated to this decision.
